services.desc: Ask any experienced Oahu angler where the big fish are, and you’ll quickly learn it’s not a random guess; it’s about understanding the island’s underwater geography. Oahu’s fishing grounds are shaped by dramatic depth changes, engineered fish aggregation points, and underwater features that concentrate baitfish and, in turn, the game fish that hunt them. Here’s a closer look at exactly where and why the big fish congregate around Oahu. Unlike many mainland fishing destinations where the ocean floor slopes gradually for miles offshore, Oahu’s underwater terrain drops off dramatically not far from shore. blurb: Guests can choose from half-day, three-quarter day, full day, and shared deep sea fishing charters departing from Oahu harbor. Fishing targets include Pacific blue marlin, striped marlin, shortbill marlin, tuna, mahi mahi, and wahoo. Charters depart mostly at 6:00 a.m., with half-day afternoon options at 12:00 p.m.
